name: Notification Item 10
definition: Provides further means of referencing a payment transaction.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the account owner, to unambiguously identify the expected credit entry.

EndToEndIdentification.name: End To End Identification
EndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the debtor, to unambiguously identify the underlying transaction to the creditor. |Usage: The end-to-end identification can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the transaction.

UETR.name: UETR
UETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Identifies the account to be credited with the incoming amount of money.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

RelatedAccount.name: Related Account
RelatedAccount.definition: Business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money expected to be credited to the account.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: Value date on which the account is expected to be credited.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.

IntermediaryAgent.name: Intermediary Agent
IntermediaryAgent.definition: Agent between the debtor agent and the account servicer.|Usage: This is the agent from which the account servicer will get the amount of money. If there is more than one intermediary agent, then IntermediaryAgent identifies the agent closest to the account servicer.|IntermediaryAgent must only be included when different from the debtor agent.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the payment transaction.

RelatedRemittanceInformation.name: Related Remittance Information
RelatedRemittanceInformation.definition: Provides information related to the handling of the remittance information by any of the agents in the transaction processing chain.

RemittanceInformation.name: Remittance Information
RemittanceInformation.definition: Structured information that enables the reconciliation of a payment with the items that the payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an account receivable system.

UnderlyingAllocation.name: Underlying Allocation
UnderlyingAllocation.definition: Provides information on the underlying allocations that make up the expected credit entry.||Usage: Only used by the Securities industry.

IntermediaryAgentAndDebtorAgentRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent is present then DebtorAgent must be present.
